question: Can you only take in a single witch gene? If you can have multiples, in the situation of “Subaru x all the witch genes = ?”, what does ? become?
answer: If you take in all the witch genes of Sloth, Wrath, Gluttony, Lust, Greed, Pride, and Envy, Subaru Natsuki becomes an entity containing all desires; in other words, he becomes “Human”!! It boils down to a result like a person eating the person-person fruit. (note: person-person fruit is a One Piece reference.)
